about: Insights from 'Widespread heat stress will become the norm in a warming Southeast Asia', Scientific Reports (2025), DOI 10.1038/s41598-025-28817-6, open access in Europe PMC as PMC12756238. It projects humid heat stress (UTCI and WBGT) across Southeast Asia at 3-hourly resolution under low- and high-emissions scenarios, with population exposure; these are projections, not measurements, and the site's wording keeps that. Set beside the future heatwaves study, which measures daily maximum temperature in India and Pakistan and does not cover Southeast Asia. A second candidate (Earth's Future, 2021) had no Europe PMC record and was not used. stage.js writes data/inbox/2026-11-sea-humid-heat/sources.json; verify-sources.yml checks each term; apply.js uses only confirmed claims.
